title: Conventional PMI - automatic termination
facts: For covered mortgages, private mortgage insurance generally must terminate automatically when the principal balance is first scheduled to reach 78% of the home's original value, if the borrower is current.
The scheduled 78% rule is based on the original amortization schedule and original value rather than simply today's estimated market value.
A separate final-termination rule generally ends PMI at the midpoint of the amortization period if it has not already ended, subject to statutory conditions.
These HPA rules do not govern FHA mortgage insurance.
